if [ -f "test.log" ] && grep -r  "log_message_part1" /path/to/log/directory "keyword1" || \
   grep -r  "log_message_part2"  /path/to/log/directory "keyword2"
   then
    echo "[INFO] 日志文件检测成功：\n  - ${LOG_DIR}/test.log\n  - ${LOG_DIR}/test_log2.log"
 else
    echo "[ERROR] 日志文件未检测到，检查路径和日志名称格式是否正确。"
fi
